stories.title: MAX17048 SOC% calibration protocol + scripts (F-048)
stories.completionNotes: Built the calibration PIPELINE, not just a script -- AC2 ('feed the threshold with real data, not a guessed constant') is unmeetable by a script alone because COLD_START_CALIBRATION_WINDOW_SECONDS=180.0 had no injection point. (1) scripts/calibrate_max17048.py: samples register SoC%/VCELL/CRATE at a fixed cadence from a cold power-up (injected clock+sleep => testable off-Pi), logs schema-free CSV (NO battery_health_log change per AC, unlike F-048's load_class='calibration' sketch), and analyzeSettling() (pure fn) measures the settle time = the empirical value the guess replaces. Prints a margin-padded recommended window + the exact config key to set. (2) Config-drove the guard: new DEFAULT pi.hardware.upsMonitor.socColdStartWindowSeconds=180.0 (provisional) in validator.py + config.json; record_drain_test._resolveColdStartWindowSeconds reads it (falls back to the constant), threaded through _recordEvent both open+close. (3) Protocol doc docs/max17048-soc-calibration-protocol.md (placed in docs/ not offices/tuner/ to respect lane discipline; AC allowed scripts/). Grounded defaults (interval 5s=UpsMonitor poll, duration 600s>=3x guard, tolerance +/-2%=2 LSB integer register, window 30s, margin x1.5/round 10s) documented in the script docstring. IN-LOOP GATES (synchronous): ruff All checks passed on all 5 .py; validate_config All validations passed; pytest tests/scripts/test_calibrate_max17048.py+test_record_drain_test.py = 37 passed; tests/test_config_validator.py = 58 passed (validator DEFAULT addition regression-checked). BENCH VALIDATION OWED (BENCH-ONLY sprint, validationCriteria): CIO runs calibrate_max17048.py on the UPS-drain rig from a cold power-up -> writes the measured settle recommendation into socColdStartWindowSeconds. Ralph did NOT fabricate the measured number (Rule 2); 180.0 stays as the grounded provisional default until the rig run. PM NOTE for US-440 doc-sync: the new socColdStartWindowSeconds config key + calibration protocol should land in specs/architecture.md Battery Health section.

stories.title: drive_detect idle-poll gap -- residual engine-on miss (F-049, verify-first + A-9 guardrails)
stories.completionNotes: BLOCKED -> BL-016 (offices/pm/blockers/BL-016-us432-idle-poll-residual-live-pi-rootcause.md). VERIFY-FIRST root-cause COMPLETE from code (did NOT re-solve the escalation): the shipped US-242 escalation fires correctly, but the RESIDUAL miss is downstream in a python-obd runtime mask. Trace: (1) supported_commands is probed ONCE at connect (obd_connection.py:408), never refreshed; (2) a cold-boot connect while the ECU is DARK (car key OFF, adapter alive on pin-16) omits RPM(0x0c) from python-obd's supported_commands; (3) queryParameter('RPM') is the LEGACY path (RPM in LEGACY_ECU_PARAMETERS, NOT PARAMETER_DECODERS) -> obd.query(cmd) with force=False returns NULL without wire traffic for an unsupported cmd (logger.py:220) -> ParameterReadError; (4) _assertPidSupported is a RED HERRING for RPM (only guards Spool-v2 decoder PIDs, logger.py:212) -- so clearing our SupportedPidSet is a no-op fix; (5) escalation swallows the null at core.py:1245 + latches _engineOnEscalated, and US-221 recovery can't help (clears ECU-silent only on a SUCCESSFUL read). => RPM masked whole connection, drive_start never fires. ALSO structural: one probe only reaches STARTING; drive_start needs sustained RPM from the regular loop, which is masked identically. WHY BLOCKED not fixed: the correct un-mask fix depends on python-obd internals + 2G K-line behavior NOT verifiable off-Pi (does a re-probe re-interrogate the ECU? is force=True clean on this ELM327? is the live backend real python-obd or a facade?). Shipping a guessed fix risks another mocked-green/IRL-miss regression -- exactly what verify-first exists to prevent (the existing escalation tests MOCK queryAndLogParameter and never exercise the real mask). BL-016 has the live-Pi repro (cold-boot key-off -> engine-on), journalctl grep tokens, and 3 fix options (A refresh supported_commands / B force RPM / C alternator-active as first-class drive_start) for the CIO bench-confirm + Atlas fix-direction ruling. Guardrail(a): no fix touched evaluateTimeouts/_maybeCloseOnDeadline/_openDriveId, so US-388 close-guarantee + drive_id NULL-latch intact. Guardrail(b): folds into the A-9 IRL re-gate. NO src/ or tests/ changed (deliberate).
acceptance: VERIFY-FIRST: US-242/B-049 already built idle->active-poll escalation on engine-on (alternator BATTERY_V + RPM-probe injection, core.py:356/1200/1212) -- root-cause the RESIDUAL gap on the live Pi, do NOT re-solve; state the specific mechanism that still misses
